1) Legal entity confirmation: the W-9 lists "Primus Health, Inc." but the onboarding form shows "Primus Health Network" as the operating name. Which should be the registered legal name for our vendor record? We default to the legal name on tax docs, but want to confirm.

2) Remit vs invoice email: you listed invoices@primushealth.com as the remit address. Is that also the inbox that will receive PO acknowledgements and invoice PDFs, or should we route POs to a separate mailbox?

Once we have those three items we can create the vendor record and provide a Redwood vendor ID and PO routing instructions. Also: are there any billing terms (Net 30/45) or invoicing constraints we should capture?

I’ve looped in Karthik from ProcureOps who will be the owner for the vendor master entry and can run the final checks.

Thanks —

1) Legal name: Please use the legal name shown on the W-9 — "Primus Health, Inc." We operate as Primus Health Network for customer-facing materials, but the legal entity for contracts and tax is Primus Health, Inc.

3) ACH/EFT: attached bank_letter_primus.pdf is on bank letterhead and includes the bank stamp and the last 4 digits of the account for validation. If you still need a voided check we can provide one Monday.

Billing terms: Net 45. We also require a PO number on all invoices for timely processing.

Attachments: primus_w9_signed.pdf (signed), bank_letter_primus.pdf (stamped), primus_coi.pdf (insurer: Harbor Insurance Co.).

Let me know if you want the DBA captured in the vendor record — happy either way.

Thanks,
Sarah
